notes: Existing valid claims remain owned by their current agents and are not migrated mid-task.
New claims must continue to the next eligible task unless a documented stop condition applies.
External prompts should not duplicate project requirements; Agents must load them from the repository.
A minimal prompt containing only the repository address and an instruction to start work is sufficient.
Git provides durable coordination and resume state; it cannot revive a host-suspended ChatGPT/Work/Codex session.
